# `sensor_bispectrum`

the bispectrum of the stored chunk spectra in eigenmode coordinates, weighted by the flow's frequency atoms - phase-amplitude coupling and harmonics, with the bicoherence's sums.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run sensor_bispectrum --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run sensor_bispectrum --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run sensor_bispectrum --dataset D --subject S --spectra NAME_chunk_spectra --atoms ATOMS [--space surface --package hodgeDirac__SURFACE [--banded true --bands BANDS]]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `spectra` | statistic any, where {"name": "$spectra"} (the chunk spectra the sensor flow pipeline stored (`nxr-neuro run sensor_flow` first: <name>_chunk_spectra)) | yes |
| `atoms` | selection any, where {"name": "$atoms"} (the frequency atoms, a kernel set on the spectra's frequency line (the flow's: `nxr-neuro run select_kernels --profile gaussian`)) | yes |
| `package` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${package}_eigenvectors"}, required false (the sensor surface's Hodge-Dirac solve the coordinates are on (space surface or band_triples)) | no |
| `bands` | selection any, where {"name": "$bands"}, when {"banded": true} (the eigenvalue bands, a kernel set on the eigenvalue line (`nxr-neuro run select_kernels --profile cos2_partition`)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spectra` | `--spectra` | none | - |  | the stored chunk spectra's name |
| `atoms` | `--atoms` | none | - |  | the frequency atoms' kernel set by name |
| `package` | `--package` | none | - |  | the Hodge-Dirac solve's stem (space surface or band_triples) |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | - |  | the eigenvalue bands' kernel set by name (banded true) |
| `readings` | `--readings` | `["phase_amplitude_coupling", "harmonics"]` | - |  | the triples read: phase_amplitude_coupling (low, high, high; Zandvoort and Nolte 2021) and harmonics (atom, atom, atom at twice its frequency; Bartz et al. 2019) |
| `normalisation` | `--normalisation` | `threenorm` | - | threenorm, kim_powers, none | the sums kept for the bicoherence: threenorm (Shahbazi Avarvand et al. 2018) \| kim_powers (Kim and Powers 1979; Hagihira et al. 2001) \| none |
| `space` | `--space` | `coordinates` | - | coordinates, surface, band_triples | coordinates (each field coordinate with itself) \| surface (each vertex of the sensor surface; per band with banded true) \| band_triples (each vertex, every triple of eigenvalue bands: coupling across spatial scales; needs banded true) |
| `banded` | `--banded` | false | - |  | space surface or band_triples: the eigenvalue bands named in bands are read (the synthesis composed with each band's gains first) |
| `frequency_normalisation` | `--frequency-normalisation` | `sum_of_squared_gains` | - | sum_of_squared_gains, none | the atoms as the flow weights them: sum_of_squared_gains \| none |
| `support_floor` | `--support-floor` | `0.001` | - |  | with sum_of_squared_gains: a bin whose atoms' squared gains sum to less than this fraction of their largest sum lies outside the atoms |
| `name` | `--name` | `{spectra}_bispectrum` | - |  | the stored statistic's name |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE BISPECTRUM IN EIGENMODE COORDINATES (spec docs/specs/2026-11-24-bispectrum.md): the relations between frequencies that survive a sum over the run (triple products), read from the
SAME stored chunk spectra the sensor flow pipeline serves (never the recording again).

THE GRAPH. before: the stored chunk spectra (signal.chunk_spectra: each chunk's spectrum in the sensor surface's field coordinates, half-chunk overlap, bins of [0, 60) Hz) + the
frequency atoms (the flow's, a kernel set) [+ the Hodge-Dirac package and the eigenvalue bands, on the surface] --[signal.bispectrum]--> per triple of atoms and per coordinate (or per
vertex, per band) B = the sum over the chunks and every pair of bins of g1 x(f1) g2 x(f2) conj(g3 x(f1 + f2)), and its normalisation's sums. Derived at read: the bicoherence, the
biphase, the peak-trough (real part) and rise-decay (imaginary part) asymmetry.
Readings (the method rule: each with its published reference as the default):
  phase_amplitude_coupling  (low atom, high atom, high atom) for every pair with the high centre above the low: bispectral phase-amplitude coupling (Zandvoort and Nolte 2021);
  harmonics                 (atom, atom, the atom at twice its frequency): the harmonics of non-sinusoidal waveforms and their shape from the biphase (Bartz et al. 2019).
Normalisation: threenorm (Shahbazi Avarvand et al. 2018, used by both references above) | kim_powers (Kim and Powers 1979; Hagihira et al. 2001) | none.
Every value below is a stated choice of this definition (the node defaults nothing). The atoms are the flow's (frequency_normalisation as sensor_flow's).

What it cannot resolve: the field on the helmet only; a whole-run sum (coupling whose phase drifts cancels; single events are the burst pipelines'); phase-amplitude coupling only where
the high atom is wider than the low frequency (each triple's weight is stored); a harmonic whose centre lies above the span is not read (left out); bicoherence is biased upward by few chunks (compare with a null).

  nxr-neuro run sensor_bispectrum --dataset D --subject S --spectra NAME_chunk_spectra --atoms ATOMS [--space surface --package hodgeDirac__SURFACE [--banded true --bands BANDS]]
```
